items.product: Command Large White Hooks / 14 hooks, 16 strips
items.purpose: Anchor the six ordered fleece blankets to suitable bedroom surfaces. Three 14-hook packs = 42 hooks; initial 6 points per blanket = 36, leaving 6 spares. This is trial inventory, not a tested attachment design. Hooks stay on wall; binder-clip handles hang from them.

items.product: Amazon Basics Medium 1.25-in binder clips / 96 Count
items.purpose: Grip fleece top edges and hang clips from large hooks. Initial 36 wall clips + 6 desk-skirt clips = 42 used, 54 spare from 96. Does not replace adhesive hooks; no extra binder-clip pack for desk.

Two thin black polyester cloths, 90 x 132 in each. Cloth 1 covers stored bed. Cloth 2 supplies 117 x~34-in desk U-skirt (front + both sides), 30 x 48-in Guardian body, 62 x 32-in dry-tub base. Existing nesting fits the latter cuts in cloth 2; actual templates/ opacity still need checking. Fleece is not spent on furniture.

items.product: Black gaffer tape / 2 in × 30 yd / 1 Pack
items.purpose: One 2 in x 30 yd black gaffer roll: moss butt-join backing underneath removable mats, scenic backing/ cloth tidying and tested perimeter cable-edge management. Not primary fleece suspension, bed restraint or direct adhesion to untested finished surfaces.

One 100-pack 8-in black ties. Reserve~12 for Guardian cardboard spine/ shoulders/ body on its independent stand; remainder for ivy attachment to existing supports and loose scenic/ cable bundles. No second Guardian tie pack.

items.product: Command clear decorating clips / 40 clips, 48 strips

Stage 80 clips/ two packs for Grove ivy and later string routing; stage 40/ one pack for Hollow desk ivy, lightweight string routing and spares. Allocation is inventory, not required mounting spacing. These are not the large fleece hooks or heavy branch/ fixture supports.

One 10-ft bendable moss vine: visible root/ branch accent around the shower backdrop and dry-tub edge. Separate from the 84-ft ivy pack; actual support/ attachment still needs fitting.
